rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people or folks in general.

example.english: There are a lot of folk here.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for one's family or the people from one's household, including one's folks back home.

example.english: My folk are still waiting for me back home.
example.traditional: 我屋企人仲喺鄉下等緊我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 zung6 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 dang2 gan2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this specifically when one's folks means one's parents rather than relatives generally.

example.english: My folk don't like me going out at night.
example.traditional: 我父母都唔鍾意我夜晚出街。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fu6 mou5 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 ngo5 je6 maan5 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for the non-parent relatives when “folks” means one's extended family.

example.english: My folk often come to my place for dinner during the New Year.
example.traditional: 我啲親戚過年成日嚟我屋企食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 di1 can1 cik1 gwo3 nin4 seng4 jat6 lei4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6
